environment: isolated local single-repository macOS/Codex test; no real GitHub event receiver or production scheduling
purpose: Original S4 acceptance scenario expectations fixed before implementation. These are verification cases, not a dependent milestone plan. Exact supported adapters will follow independently judged M0.

cases.input: Deliver a new authorized code revision through a supported local trigger.
cases.expected: Pinned input leads through actual author and independent review to matching docs/baseline/receipt; no repeated human draft approval; actual calls and duration recorded.

cases.input: Deliver an authorized behavior goal from local request/document trigger.
cases.expected: Preserve current versus target; implementation and mandatory checks/review tied to exact goal; doc application and implementation verification separately recorded; failed implementation never means complete.

cases.input: Redeliver the same event before and after completion, including concurrent deliveries.
cases.expected: One owned execution/effect; stable cause/request links; duplicate must not repeat model/implementation/doc effects; actual artifacts compared.

cases.input: Deliver v1 after v2 and a delayed v1 successful result after v2 becomes authoritative.
cases.expected: Older event/result retained as history; no current baseline or newer goal regression.

cases.input: Submit same contents with a distinct new user request ID.
cases.expected: New request distinguishable from transport replay; unchanged effects reused only after identity/current-state checks.

cases.input: Feed document-generated implementation and its code-generated documentation events back to the intake.
cases.expected: Causation remains linked; finite runs/effects, no feedback loop; genuine unrelated new input still processed.

cases.input: Drop response after actual local document apply committed.
cases.expected: Unknown outcome reconciled via public status and actual bytes/baseline/receipt before retry; no false failure/success or duplicate effects.

cases.input: Inject model outage/malformed result, transport/network failure, expired permission and service failure at side-effect boundaries.
cases.expected: Evidence-based classification; bounded retry or explicit wait/stop with resume point; actual model evidence separated from injected transport fixture; no completed unperformed step.

cases.input: Give an unresolved policy choice then a recorded decision.
cases.expected: Question includes conflicting evidence, impact and options; same execution resumes after decision; ordinary repairs avoid human policy wait.

cases.input: Event config asks for unauthorized implementation or remote write.
cases.expected: Config cannot supply missing user authority; zero unapproved remote effects. Local-only test is reported as such, not remote service success.

cases.input: Commit source change without delivering its event, then allow actual periodic check to run.
cases.expected: Missed change discovered and routed automatically; actual repeated timer/poll execution evidence, not hand-invoked one-shot CLI.

cases.input: Introduce baseline/doc drift, lose a tracked source, retain an approved unimplemented target.
cases.expected: Distinct findings identify each cause; approved target preserved as pending, not rewritten into current state; unresolved source/policy is explicit.

cases.input: Allow repeated checks without changes or changed actionable status.
cases.expected: No rewrite, model call or repeated notification; actual artifact hashes/counts show quiet behavior.

cases.input: Operator stops a run during a bounded operation and resumes it.
cases.expected: No new work while stopped; in-flight/unknown state recorded truthfully; resume reconciles same run and preserves evidence.

cases.input: Concurrent attempts target same document root; outside editor changes a reviewed target.
cases.expected: Declared local ownership boundary honored; competing/third bytes fail safely and are preserved; project SQLite alone not claimed as universal lock.
